title: Polizei Berlin zieht Bilanz zur Versammlungslage am 1. Mai 2026

extraction.summaryEn: Police reviewed the May Day 2026 demonstrations across Berlin, with over 90 assemblies and more than 70,000 participants. During the evening Kreuzberg march, a police officer was lightly injured after being hit by bottles, and 15 officers were injured overall.
